text:
maria (Finance): Heads up — daily cost job flagged a ~20% jump in Dedicated GPU spend in us-west-2 starting ~03:00 UTC. Lots of it shows up as UNASSIGNED in the cost UI. Link: https://billing.internal/redwood/costs?range=24h&filter=dedicated-us-west-2

deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Cost Alert: dedicated-pool 'dedicated-xlarge' spike detected. Delta=+19.6% vs baseline. Investigators: #finance #eng-infra

raj (FinOps): I pulled the billing export — there are ~7 instances launched by project acme-trial-001 with empty `team` and `cost_center` labels. Likely the onboarding script omitted billing labels. I can run the quick query to list resource IDs.
```
SELECT resource.labels.instance_id, labels
FROM `billing_export.gcp_resource_usage`
WHERE project_id = 'acme-trial-001' AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
```

 taylor (Platform Eng): That was from our onboarding lambda — we shipped a change yesterday to allow ad-hoc pools. Confirmed we missed adding `billing:acme` labels when creating Dedicated VMs. Rolling a fix now, ETA ~25m. Sorry for the noise.

maria (Finance): Can we retroactively attribute the last 8 hours to ACME? They are on a trial and we need to either invoice them or absorb the cost. Rough est from the export: ~$12k. If we can backfill labels in the export, finance can re-run attribution.

raj (FinOps): Backfill path: apply labels at resource level and then trigger a backfill job that reprocesses the billing export into BigQuery. High-level steps I'll run if we have permission: 1) identify instance IDs 2) add labels via gcloud 3) run backfill job. Example command:
```
for id in INSTANCE_ID_LIST; do
  gcloud compute instances add-labels $id --labels=team=acme,cost_center=acme-trial --project=acme-trial-001 --zone=us-west2-a
done
```
I'll need either owner perms on the project or confirmation from Sales Ops to act.

olivia (Sales Ops): ACME onboarding ticket #12345 — they told us to manage resources for the trial. I'll DM legal + customer contact for explicit tagging consent and post here once I have thumbs-up. If they approve, send the exact instance list and I'll attach the permission note to the ticket.

taylor (Platform Eng): Posting the resource snapshot I have (partial): instance-acme-001, instance-acme-002, instance-acme-gpu-03, instance-acme-gpu-04. Full list attached to the deploy logs (internal link). Command I'm about to run in staging to validate label logic:
```
# dry-run
gcloud compute instances add-labels instance-acme-001 --labels=team=acme,cost_center=acme-trial --project=acme-trial-001 --zone=us-west2-a --quiet --dry-run
```
Then I'll promote to prod after confirmation.

maria (Finance): Please cc finance when you run the backfill so we can reprocess. I'll create invoice draft invoice-ACME-TRIAL-MAR and hold sending until we confirm attribution. Also please put a short alert so future onboarding launches without labels create a pager or at minimum an email to #finance.

raj (FinOps): Created short-term monitor: alert rule 'unlabeled-dedicated-launch' -> notifies #finance and #eng-infra and the oncall rotation. Added a runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/unlabeled-dedicated. PR for onboarding fix is up: https://git.internal/r/redwood/onboarding/pull/678 (waiting review).

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded — onboarding-service tag-fix v1.0.3 rolled to prod at 03:20 UTC.

maria (Finance): Thanks all. Once the backfill is done, we'll reconcile and either bill the trial or move to internal absorption. Marking this thread for retro-billing and keeping open until invoice status is set. :white_check_mark:
